_doc: A1 風格條件生成。與 a0_smoke_test 的差別只在 model 這條線上多串了 IPAdapter：CheckpointLoader -> IPAdapterUnifiedLoader -> IPAdapterAdvanced -> KSampler。參考圖須放在 comfyui/input/ 下，由節點 9 的 image 欄指定檔名。依美術聖經 §2 對策 2：一律用參考圖條件生成，不用純文字 prompt。

inputs.text: full body game sprite of a single standing character, head to toe fully visible, 3/4 front view, centered, isolated on a plain flat neutral background. SUBJECT: a 17th-century Ming loyalist musketeer of Koxinga's army. East Asian face, clean shaven, hair in a topknot under a conical lacquered iron helmet forming a clear triangular silhouette. A deep terracotta red Ming military tunic, cloth leg wraps, BARE FEET. Holding a matchlock arquebus. PROPORTIONS: 4 heads tall, solid weighty build, clear shoulder mass, readable silhouette at 128 pixels.
